name: Smart Inventory Tracker
idea: Create a web‑based inventory management system for small retailers. Features: QR code scanning, real‑time stock updates, low‑stock alerts, user roles, basic analytics. Design: minimalist, dark theme. Audience: micro‑retailers in India. Monetisation: freemium SaaS, 1‑year free, $5/month pro. Use React + Node + PostgreSQL. Deploy on Vercel. Provide GitHub repo. Use Claude Code to scaffold.
